thread:
sam: Thinking aloud — can we introduce ingress sampling for long-tail requests to make smarter hedging + cost-accounting decisions?

sam: Idea: mark a small fraction of requests as "sampled" (header `X-RW-Sample: 1`) and propagate that id through retries/hedges so telemetry and billing aggregation don't double-count.

morgan: +1 on sampling, but only for >95th/99th percentile latency candidates. Otherwise we'll skew metrics.

morgan: Also: sampling sticky across retries is key — if a sampled request is retried/hedged, it should keep the same sample-id.

dalia: For streaming flows we need to be careful — you can't just sample a request and then drop streaming events. Suggest we sample at ingress and mirror the sampling flag into stream metadata, and ensure partial responses still get correlated.

dalia: Also: sanitize any sampled payloads before they leave the edge for analytics (PII risk). :lock:

jia: Telemetry side: we should emit a single aggregated record per sampled request containing: sample-id, final outcome (success/abort/fallback), token-counts, latency, model-variant, and hedging decisions. That will let us estimate full-population metrics.

jia: Pseudocode for ingress decision:

```
if rand() < SAMPLE_RATE and is_candidate_for_long_tail(req):
  req.headers['X-RW-Sample']=1
  req.headers['X-RW-Sample-ID']=uuid()
else:
  // no headers
```

jia: Downstream proxies/serving must copy X-RW-Sample-ID into all emitted traces/metrics. Billing aggregation uses sampled-token-sum * (1/SAMPLE_RATE) as estimator.

ops-bot: config change deployed to staging: `feature.ingress_sampling = true` at 0.5% default. See https://go.redwood/internal/ingress-sampling

morgan: Two more caveats: (1) ensure that hedging doesn't create double-sampled counts — if a sampled request triggers a hedge, only one hedged replica should be counted in the sampled aggregator, (2) sample IDs should be short-lived and rotated regularly.

sam: Good point. Proposal: sample at ingress; mark sample-id; on hedges, add header `X-RW-Sample-Replica: 1/2/primary` and only the replica with `primary` writes sampled aggregate. Default hedging policy keeps replica roles deterministically by hash of sample-id so it's stable.

dalia: For streaming with resumable chunks, include the sample-id in the stream open and stream-trailer. That lets us join partial token counts even if stream disconnects and resumes.

jia: We'll also need dashboards: sampled_latency_p99_estimate, sampled_token_cost_estimate, sampled_hedge_rate. I'll sketch a grafana panel set and an alert for sample_error_rate > 0.5%.

sam: Action items: (1) morgan/dalia to draft small RFC for headers and hedging semantics, (2) jia to define sampled telemetry schema, (3) infra to enable sample-safe billing estimator. I'll own the RFC.

sam: Thanks — I'll drop a short RFC by EOD and link to the staging flag.
